attributes.name: Title
attributes.value: Gene expression profiles in spinal cord of control and sporadic Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis patients

attributes.name: Title
attributes.value: Gene expression profiles in spinal cord of control and sporadic Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis patients

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: We performed gene expression profiles of spinal cord samples of ALS patients (30) and controls (10) in order to obtain transcriptomics information belonging to different brain regions of ALS patients. Motor cortex gene expression profiles of the same patients were previously submitted (E-MTAB-2325) and published.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Fresh-frozen samples were obtained post-mortem and selected for post-mortem intervals prior to freezing not exceeding 24 hours.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: RNA was extracted with Trizol (Invitrogen) following the manufacturer's standard protocol, followed by confirmation of RNA integrity by agarose gel electrophoresis.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Complementary RNAs (cRNAs) labeled with Cy3-CTP (Perkin-Elmer) were synthesized from 1 ug of total RNA of each sample using the Low RNA Input Fluorescent Linear Amplification Kit (Agilent Technologies) following the manufacturer's protocol. Aliquots (750 ng) of Cy3 labeled cRNA targets were hybridized on Whole Human Genome Oligo Microarrays (Agilent Technologies).

attributes.name: Type
attributes.value: nucleic acid hybridization to array protocol

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Microarray hybridization and washing were performed using reagents and instruments (hybridization chambers and rotating oven) as indicated by the manufacturer (Agilent Technologies).

attributes.name: Type
attributes.value: array scanning and feature extraction protocol

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Microarrays were scanned at 10-μm resolution using a GenePix Personal 4100A microarray scanner and the GenePix Pro 6.0 acquisition and data-extraction software (Molecular Devices, Corp.).
